major_cooldowns.name: Avatar
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast Avatar on cooldown and line up your other burst cooldowns and empowered casts inside its window for the full damage amplification.

major_cooldowns.name: Ravager
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast Ravager on cooldown, ideally while Avatar or Demoralizing Shout is active so its Rage generation and damage line up with your amplified window.

major_cooldowns.name: Demolish
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: As Colossus, cast Demolish on cooldown once Colossal Might is stacked and do not delay it for Avatar or Demoralizing Shout unless the target would die before you get another cast in.

major_cooldowns.name: Demoralizing Shout
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: With Booming Voice talented, cast Demoralizing Shout on cooldown for the Rage and damage, syncing it with Avatar when it lines up, but delay it if you know a bigger incoming damage window is coming and you have nothing else up.

rule.description: Ravager into Charge, Avatar, Thunder Clap, Shield Block
rule.action: Open with Ravager, Charge in, pop Avatar as you charge, then Thunder Clap, Shield Block, Shield Slam, Demoralizing Shout, Demolish, and Shield Charge in that order.

rule.description: Save Ravager, Demolish, Shield Charge for Avatar
rule.action: Line up Ravager, Demolish, and Shield Charge with Avatar or Demoralizing Shout instead of firing them the instant they come off cooldown, unless the fight will not let you sync them again.

rule.description: Execute yields to Revenge past 4 targets
rule.action: With Heavy Handed talented, use Execute over Revenge against 1 to 4 enemies, but switch to Revenge once more than 4 enemies are up.

rule.description: Spend Sudden Death on Execute immediately
rule.action: Cast Execute as soon as Sudden Death procs instead of letting it time out.

rule.description: Spend Burst of Power on Shield Slam immediately
rule.action: Cast your next two Shield Slams right away when Burst of Power procs since it removes their cooldown.

rule.description: Keep Shield Block up while tanking
rule.action: Recast Shield Block before it falls off whenever you are actively tanking melee damage; it is your primary mitigation tool.
